targets.rawSQL: SELECT approx_percentile(lag_ms, 0.5) / 1000.0 AS p50_s FROM lag_samples WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM lag_samples ORDER BY commit_ts DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT approx_percentile(lag_ms, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS p95_s FROM lag_samples WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM lag_samples ORDER BY commit_ts DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT approx_percentile(lag_ms, 0.99) / 1000.0 AS p99_s FROM lag_samples WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM lag_samples ORDER BY commit_ts DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) / ((MAX(commit_ts) - MIN(produce_ts)) / 1000.0) AS throughput_per_s FROM lag_samples WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM lag_samples ORDER BY commit_ts DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT from_unixtime(commit_ts / 1000) AS time, approx_percentile(lag_ms, 0.5) / 1000.0 AS p50, approx_percentile(lag_ms, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS p95, approx_percentile(lag_ms, 0.99) / 1000.0 AS p99 FROM lag_samples WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM lag_samples ORDER BY commit_ts DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY from_unixtime(commit_ts / 1000) ORDER BY time

SELECT config_label, COUNT(*) AS samples, approx_percentile(lag_ms, 0.5) / 1000.0 AS p50_s, approx_percentile(lag_ms, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS p95_s, approx_percentile(lag_ms, 0.99) / 1000.0 AS p99_s, MAX(lag_ms) / 1000.0 AS max_s, COUNT(*) / ((MAX(commit_ts) - MIN(produce_ts)) / 1000.0) AS throughput_per_s FROM lag_samples GROUP BY config_label ORDER BY p95_s
